content.text: Level 2: callers of `availabilityAsString`, plus callers of the enclosing functions in the three components.

Changing `nameOfDay`'s signature (`packages/lib/weekday.ts`) could break 14 files besides `weekday.ts` itself. I found them by text search for the names, so I haven't type-checked them.

**Level 1: files that call `nameOfDay` directly (5)**
- `packages/lib/weekday.test.ts`: tests it directly.
- `packages/lib/availability.ts`: `availabilityAsString` calls it at line 151.
- `apps/web/modules/users/components/UserForm.tsx`: calls it at lines 84–90.
- `apps/web/modules/settings/my-account/general-view.tsx`: calls it at lines 94–100.
- `apps/web/modules/bookings/components/AvailableTimesHeader.tsx`: calls it at line 53.

**Level 2: files that call a function that calls it (9)**
- Callers of `availabilityAsString`:
  - `packages/features/schedules/components/ScheduleListItem.tsx`
  - `packages/platform/atoms/availability/AvailabilitySettings.tsx`
  - `apps/web/test/lib/availabilityAsString.test.ts`
- Callers of `AvailableTimesHeader`:
  - `apps/web/modules/bookings/components/AvailableTimeSlots.tsx`
  - `apps/web/modules/embed/components/Embed.tsx`
- Callers of `UserForm`:
  - `apps/web/modules/users/views/users-add-view.tsx`
  - `apps/web/modules/users/views/users-edit-view.tsx`
- Callers of `GeneralView`:
  - `apps/web/app/(use-page-wrapper)/settings/(settings-layout)/my-account/general/page.tsx`

I left out `TravelScheduleModal.tsx`, which only imports the `FormValues` type from `general-view`. I also left out `Booker.tsx` and `EditUserSheet.tsx`, which only matched on similar names (`hideAvailableTimesHeader`, `EditUserForm`).

Level 2 files can only break if the signature change alters what the level-1 functions return or take, such as `availabilityAsString`'s output or the components' props. If you keep those stable, only the level-1 files are at risk.
